note: 102 styles described by technique and movement traits — never copy a specific work or a living artist; reference_sources list what was actually opened.

styles.name: Loose Watercolour
styles.name_th: สีน้ำแบบลื่นไหล
styles.historical_background: Watercolour is a semi-transparent paint of pigment in a water-soluble binder, usually on paper, where the unpainted paper supplies the light (Tate, 'Watercolour'). Tate's examples run from Turner's The Blue Rigi, Sunrise (1842) to Klee (1927); the loose, wet-into-wet manner is a long-standing practice of plein-air sketchers rather than a named movement.
styles.visual_characteristics: Transparent washes, soft blooms and backruns, white paper left as highlights, edges that dissolve into the page.
styles.line_characteristics: Few or no outlines; edges come from wash boundaries; occasional dry-brush or thin pen accents.
styles.shape_language: Suggestive, broken silhouettes; lost-and-found edges; big simple masses.
styles.color_characteristics: Limited palette (3–5 pigments), colours mixed on the paper, granulation in blues and earths, high value range from paper white.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Light is the paper itself; soft diffuse daylight reads best; strong darks used sparingly.
styles.texture_characteristics: Cold-press paper tooth, pigment granulation, hard dried edges (cauliflowers) where wet meets damp.
styles.composition_characteristics: Large quiet wash areas plus one sharp focal zone; vignetted edges fading to white paper.
styles.emotional_characteristics: Fresh, airy, spontaneous, gentle; can turn melancholic in grey palettes.
styles.time_optic_fit: Good for soft backgrounds and seasonal moods behind a real frame photo; poor for showing frame detail itself (washes blur hinges and lens edges), so keep the product as a photo/cutout layer on top.
common_mistakes: muddy watercolour from too many overlapping colours
uniform digital blur passing as wash
no white paper left, everything tinted
outlined cartoon plus watercolour fill that looks like colouring-book
AI text-like scribbles in the washes
styles.prompt_template: Loose transparent watercolour painting of {subject} in {setting}, wet-into-wet washes with soft blooms, white paper left for highlights, limited {palette} palette, {lighting}, {composition}, visible cold-press paper texture, edges fading into the white page, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Loose transparent watercolour painting of a small corner optical shop in a quiet Bangkok soi in the morning, wet-into-wet washes with soft blooms, white paper left for highlights, limited palette of deep green, warm grey and a touch of peach, soft overcast daylight, shop placed on the left third with a large calm sky wash, visible cold-press paper texture, edges fading into the white page, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: FLUX.1 schnell tends to produce a clean 'digital watercolour' with tidy edges and splatter clichés; ask for 'granulation', 'hard dried edges', 'white paper' and lower detail. img2img at denoise ~0.55 over a simple sketch keeps structure.

styles.name: Botanical Watercolour
styles.name_th: สีน้ำพฤกษศาสตร์
styles.historical_background: Botanical illustration grew from herbals and scientific plant records, where accuracy of form, colour and structure mattered more than mood. The controlled, layered watercolour approach is craft practice; no museum page was opened for this entry, so details are given as practice, not history.
styles.visual_characteristics: Single specimen on white, precise contours, glazed layers building form, every vein and petal edge resolved.
styles.line_characteristics: Fine graphite underdrawing kept invisible or very faint; edges defined by colour, not ink.
styles.shape_language: Organic but exact; true proportions; leaves and stems as rhythmic curves.
styles.color_characteristics: Faithful local colour built in thin glazes; subtle temperature shifts in shadows; no artistic recolouring.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Even, soft, conventionally from upper left; gentle cast shadow or none.
styles.texture_characteristics: Smooth hot-press paper, almost invisible brush marks, dry-brush for fuzz and veins.
styles.composition_characteristics: Isolated specimen with generous white margin; sometimes detail insets of seed, flower section.
styles.time_optic_fit: Fits as a decorative layer (leaves around a frame photo, nature-themed lens info) and suits the trusted-expert tone; not for scenes or people.
common_mistakes: impossible plant anatomy (wrong leaf count, fused petals)
loud splatter added to 'make it watercolour'
styles.prompt_template: Botanical watercolour study of {subject}, precise contours, thin layered glazes, accurate structure, {palette}, {lighting}, {composition}, isolated on white hot-press paper with generous margins, no text, no labels.
styles.prompt_example: Botanical watercolour study of a sprig of jasmine and pandan leaves arranged as a frame border, precise contours, thin layered glazes, accurate structure, fresh greens with creamy whites, soft even light from upper left, empty centre space for a glasses photo, isolated on white hot-press paper with generous margins, no text, no labels.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
vintage botanical print with latin labels
styles.flux_notes: Usually good at clean botanical layouts but invents labels and pseudo-latin text; always add 'no text, no labels'. Leaf anatomy errors are common; check counts.

styles.name: Flat Gouache
styles.name_th: สีกวอชแบนเรียบ
styles.historical_background: Gouache is a water-soluble paint that, unlike watercolour, is opaque: more binder and added inert pigment such as chalk build a covering layer (Tate, 'Gouache'). Its matte, even coverage made it a long-time medium for designers' layouts and posters.
styles.visual_characteristics: Opaque matte colour shapes, crisp edges, minimal gradients, slight hand-made unevenness.
styles.line_characteristics: Edges formed by shape meeting shape; occasional thin brush line; no hard black outline.
styles.shape_language: Simplified, geometric-organic shapes; clear silhouettes; designed rather than observed.
styles.color_characteristics: Limited flat palette of 4–6 mixed colours, light over dark possible, chalky matte finish.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Light shown as one or two flat value steps; cast shadows as solid shapes.
styles.texture_characteristics: Faint brush streaks, dry edges, paper grain under thin areas.
styles.composition_characteristics: Graphic, poster-like; strong figure-ground; room for type.
styles.time_optic_fit: Strong fit for carousels and tip posts; matches brand flat colours well (phthalo green, peach accent). Frame details must be simplified or kept as a photo layer.
common_mistakes: vector-perfect fills that lose the paint feel
glossy highlights that contradict matte gouache
styles.prompt_template: Flat opaque gouache illustration of {subject} in {setting}, matte chalky colour shapes with crisp edges, faint brush streaks, limited {palette}, {lighting} shown as simple flat value steps, {composition}, space left for text, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Flat opaque gouache illustration of a person cleaning their glasses with a microfibre cloth at a café table, matte chalky colour shapes with crisp edges, faint brush streaks, limited palette of deep green, snow white, warm grey and a peach accent, soft window light shown as two flat value steps, subject on the right third with open space on the left, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: FLUX leans to clean vector-flat; adding 'matte gouache, brush streaks, paper grain' helps. Hands holding glasses often break; keep hands simple or out of frame.

styles.name: Storybook Gouache
styles.name_th: กวอชหนังสือนิทาน
styles.historical_background: Picture-book illustration has long used gouache because its opacity allows layered, soft, controllable colour (Tate, 'Gouache' for the medium). The storybook look described here is an illustration practice, not a dated movement.
styles.visual_characteristics: Soft rounded forms, painterly but tidy, warm glowing light, cosy detailed settings.
styles.line_characteristics: Soft edges, occasional coloured-pencil line over paint; no harsh outlines.
styles.shape_language: Rounded, chunky, child-friendly proportions; big heads, small hands; soft corners.
styles.color_characteristics: Warm, slightly desaturated harmonious palette with a glowing accent; dusk blues against lamp oranges.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Warm practical light sources, soft glow, gentle rim light.
styles.texture_characteristics: Visible paper and dry-brush grain, light speckle, coloured-pencil hatching.
styles.composition_characteristics: Readable stage-like scenes, character centred in a framed environment, clear storytelling poses.
use_cases: story clips (ร้านแว่นตีสอง backgrounds)
styles.time_optic_fit: Good for story clips and kids' first-glasses content; warmth suits a neighbourhood shop. Avoid for premium frame promos where it can feel childish.
common_mistakes: glow everywhere so nothing is focal
copying a specific famous picture-book look
styles.prompt_template: Storybook gouache illustration of {subject} in {setting}, soft rounded forms, warm painterly gouache with dry-brush and paper grain, {palette}, {lighting} with gentle glow, {composition}, cosy readable scene, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Storybook gouache illustration of a sleepy cat sitting on the counter of a tiny optical shop at 2 a.m., glasses displays glowing softly, soft rounded forms, warm painterly gouache with dry-brush and paper grain, dusk blue and lamp amber palette with deep green shelves, warm practical desk-lamp glow, cat centred within the shop window frame, cosy readable scene, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: FLUX does warm storybook well but drifts to glossy 3D faces; add 'flat painted faces, paper grain, gouache'. Keep characters consistent with img2img from a previous frame.

styles.name: Classical Oil Painting
styles.name_th: สีน้ำมันคลาสสิก
styles.historical_background: Layered oil painting on panel and canvas dominated European art from the Renaissance, which began in Italy around 1400 with its High Renaissance c.1500–1530 (Tate, 'Renaissance'). The classical method of underpainting, glazing and blended modelling persisted in academies into the nineteenth century.
styles.visual_characteristics: Smooth blended modelling, deep transparent shadows, rich glazes, polished finish.
styles.line_characteristics: No visible line; forms turn through soft gradations; edges varied from soft to crisp.
styles.shape_language: Naturalistic, idealised proportions; stable pyramidal groupings.
styles.color_characteristics: Earth-based palette (ochres, umbers, vermilion, ultramarine), warm lights and cool transparent darks.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Single directional light, often north-window or chiaroscuro modelling.
styles.texture_characteristics: Fine canvas weave, smooth glaze surface, slight craquelure on aged look.
styles.composition_characteristics: Balanced, often triangular or centred; dark backgrounds isolating the subject.
styles.time_optic_fit: Can lend prestige to a luxury frame campaign (portrait wearing the frame), but heavy and old-fashioned for daily posts; keep sparse.
common_mistakes: plastic airbrushed skin calling itself oil
modern glasses rendered as melted shapes
orange-brown 'old master' filter instead of real temperature control
styles.prompt_template: Classical oil painting of {subject} in {setting}, smooth blended modelling with transparent glazes, warm lights and cool deep shadows, {palette}, {lighting}, {composition}, fine canvas texture, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Classical oil painting portrait of a middle-aged Thai man wearing thin gold round glasses, seated in a dark-panelled study, smooth blended modelling with transparent glazes, warm lights and cool deep shadows, ochre, umber and deep green palette, single north-window light from the left, triangular half-length composition, fine canvas texture, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Gets the general look; glasses on painted faces often lose a temple arm or warp lens shape. Use a real frame reference via Codex -i when the frame must be accurate.

styles.name: Oil Impasto
styles.name_th: สีน้ำมันปาดหนา
styles.historical_background: Impasto is paint laid on so thickly that it forms a raised, textured surface; Tate cites Titian, Tintoretto and Rubens, and modern examples such as Frank Auerbach's Head of E.O.W. I (1960), noting moderns valued it for expressing emotion (Tate, 'Impasto').
styles.visual_characteristics: Thick ridged strokes, palette-knife slabs, paint catching real light, energetic surface.
styles.line_characteristics: Lines are stroke edges; directional brushwork describes form.
styles.color_characteristics: Juicy, high-chroma strokes placed side by side, partially mixed on the canvas.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Strong directional light emphasising stroke relief.
styles.texture_characteristics: Raised paint ridges, knife marks, broken colour.
styles.composition_characteristics: Bold, simple; surface energy carries the image.
styles.time_optic_fit: Works as an abstract textured background for colourful frames; poor for any detail-critical product or face.
styles.prompt_template: Thick oil impasto painting of {subject} in {setting}, heavy palette-knife and brush strokes with raised paint ridges, {palette}, {lighting} raking across the paint relief, {composition}, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Thick oil impasto painting of an abstract summer sea and sky as a backdrop, heavy palette-knife strokes with raised paint ridges, turquoise, deep green and peach palette, warm side light raking across the paint relief, low horizon with large sky area for a product cutout, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Decent texture but tends to generic swirls; 'palette knife slabs, varied stroke size' helps. Untested on faces in this project.

styles.name: Bold Acrylic
styles.name_th: สีอะคริลิกจัดจ้าน
styles.historical_background: Acrylic is a fast-drying water-based paint with a synthetic resin binder; it emerged in the 1950s and was widely adopted in the 1960s, with David Hockney an early advocate (Tate, 'Acrylic paint').
styles.visual_characteristics: Bright, saturated, hard-edged or brushy areas; satin finish; clean overlays.
styles.line_characteristics: Crisp masking-tape edges or confident brush contours.
styles.shape_language: Bold, simplified, often hard-edge geometry or punchy organic forms.
styles.color_characteristics: High chroma, strong complementary pairs, flat or lightly graded fields.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Bright sunlight feel, hard shadows as shapes.
styles.texture_characteristics: Smooth to slightly brushy, satin sheen, little paper texture.
styles.composition_characteristics: Graphic, poster-like, strong colour blocks.
styles.time_optic_fit: Good for sunglasses and summer content; brand palette is muted so use bold acrylic as an occasional accent.
styles.prompt_template: Bold acrylic painting of {subject} in {setting}, saturated flat colour fields and crisp edges, satin finish, {palette}, {lighting} with hard shadow shapes, {composition}, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Bold acrylic painting of a poolside deck with a sun lounger and a striped towel, saturated flat colour fields and crisp edges, turquoise, coral and cream palette, hard midday sun with sharp shadow shapes, high horizon and empty centre for sunglasses cutout, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Handles flat bold colour well; may over-saturate. Untested for long series consistency.

styles.name: Soft Pastel
styles.name_th: สีชอล์กพาสเทลนุ่ม
styles.historical_background: Pastel is pure pigment with a binder pressed into sticks, in soft, hard and pencil forms (Tate, 'Pastel'). The page opened gives no history, so no dates are claimed here.
styles.visual_characteristics: Velvety powdery colour, blended passages, broken strokes on toned paper.
styles.line_characteristics: Side-of-stick strokes and edge lines; soft, broken contours.
styles.color_characteristics: Luminous pure pigment, light tints on mid-toned paper, paper colour showing through.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Soft diffuse light, glowing highlights laid last.
styles.texture_characteristics: Paper tooth catching pigment, dusty grain, smudges.
styles.composition_characteristics: Simple, intimate; vignette onto toned paper.
styles.time_optic_fit: Suits calm quote and wellness content; too soft for crisp product shots.
styles.prompt_template: Soft pastel drawing of {subject} in {setting}, velvety powdery strokes on mid-toned paper, paper tooth visible, blended passages and broken edges, {palette}, {lighting}, {composition}, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Soft pastel drawing of an elderly woman resting her eyes by a window with her reading glasses folded on her lap, velvety powdery strokes on warm grey toned paper, paper tooth visible, blended passages and broken edges, muted rose, sage and cream palette, soft window side light, figure off-centre with calm empty wall, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: 'Pastel' alone gives pale pastel-colour digital art; specify 'soft pastel sticks on toned paper, dusty grain'.

styles.name: Realistic Graphite
styles.name_th: ดินสอเหมือนจริง
styles.historical_background: Graphite pencil drawing is an academic and observational practice; careful tonal rendering in graded pencils (H to B) is taught as craft. No museum page was opened for this entry.
styles.visual_characteristics: Smooth tonal gradients, precise proportions, metallic sheen in darks, white paper highlights.
styles.line_characteristics: Fine controlled lines blended into tone; directional hatching where visible.
styles.color_characteristics: Monochrome grey scale; warm or cool paper tint optional.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Single clear light source to model form; cast shadows carefully rendered.
styles.texture_characteristics: Paper grain, blending-stump smoothness, graphite shine.
styles.composition_characteristics: Subject on white, often vignetted; close studies.
styles.time_optic_fit: Good for craftsmanship stories (a frame drawn then revealed as photo). AI rarely draws exact frame geometry; trace or img2img from the real cutout.
common_mistakes: photo turned grey and called a drawing
lens reflections drawn as solid white blobs
styles.prompt_template: Realistic graphite pencil drawing of {subject} in {setting}, smooth tonal gradients, crisp edges where light meets form, paper grain visible, {lighting}, {composition}, monochrome on white paper, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Realistic graphite pencil drawing of a pair of thick acetate glasses folded on an open book, smooth tonal gradients, crisp edges where light meets form, paper grain visible, single soft window light from the left, three-quarter view centred with white margin, monochrome on white paper, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Good tonal drawings; glasses geometry may be asymmetric. Use img2img with the real cutout at denoise 0.45–0.6.

styles.name: Loose Pencil Sketch
styles.name_th: สเก็ตช์ดินสอหลวมๆ
styles.historical_background: Quick pencil sketching for ideas and studies is a universal studio practice rather than a historical style. This project already uses a pencil duo look for the Slowly Growing channel. No external source opened.
styles.visual_characteristics: Energetic searching lines, construction lines left in, partial shading, unfinished edges.
styles.line_characteristics: Varied-weight gestural lines, repeated strokes, light construction underneath.
styles.shape_language: Gesture first; simple forms; open contours.
styles.color_characteristics: Graphite grey on off-white; optional single colour accent.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Shading suggested by quick hatching on one side only.
styles.texture_characteristics: Paper tooth, smudges, eraser marks.
styles.composition_characteristics: Vignetted sketch floating on the page; lots of white.
styles.time_optic_fit: Already proven in this project (pencil duo stories); good for gentle, human content. Keep text in HTML layer.
common_mistakes: AI scribble that never resolves into form
styles.prompt_template: Loose pencil sketch of {subject} in {setting}, gestural searching lines with construction lines left visible, quick hatching shadows, {lighting}, {composition}, graphite on off-white paper, lots of white space, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Loose pencil sketch of two friends laughing on a bench, one pushing up her glasses, gestural searching lines with construction lines left visible, quick hatching shadows, soft side light, figures on the lower third with lots of empty paper above for speech bubbles, graphite on off-white paper, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Used in this project via tools/flux.py; good results, faces vary between frames, so reuse seed/img2img for character consistency.

styles.name: Coloured Pencil
styles.name_th: ดินสอสี
styles.historical_background: Coloured pencil is a wax- or oil-based pigment pencil used for layered, burnished illustration. No museum source opened; described as craft practice.
styles.visual_characteristics: Layered hatched colour, visible stroke direction, soft burnished blends, paper white sparkle.
styles.line_characteristics: Fine directional hatching; outlines in darker colour pencil.
styles.color_characteristics: Optical mixing of layered strokes; slightly waxy, moderately saturated.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Soft, cheerful daylight; highlights left as paper.
styles.texture_characteristics: Paper tooth showing through, waxy sheen in burnished areas.
styles.composition_characteristics: Vignette or full scene; illustrative.
styles.time_optic_fit: Good for family and kids' eye-test content; less premium.
styles.prompt_template: Coloured pencil illustration of {subject} in {setting}, layered directional hatching, burnished soft blends, paper tooth showing, {palette}, {lighting}, {composition}, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Coloured pencil illustration of a child trying on her first pair of round red glasses in front of a shop mirror, layered directional hatching, burnished soft blends, paper tooth showing, warm reds, deep green and cream palette, soft daylight from a front window, child on the right third looking at her reflection, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Untested in this project; expect a mix of pencil and marker looks; 'directional hatching, paper tooth' recommended.

styles.name: Expressive Charcoal
styles.name_th: ถ่านแบบแสดงอารมณ์
styles.historical_background: Charcoal is a crumbly carbon drawing material, traditionally willow twigs heated without oxygen, with compressed charcoal developed in the twentieth century; it is used for sketching, underdrawing and finished drawings (Tate, 'Charcoal'). The project's charcoal story carousels use the expressive variant.
styles.visual_characteristics: Deep velvety blacks, smudged greys, bold sweeping marks, erased highlights.
styles.line_characteristics: Thick-thin gestural strokes, side-of-stick sweeps, eraser lines cut into tone.
styles.shape_language: Big simple masses; silhouettes; forms emerging from darkness.
styles.color_characteristics: Black to paper white; optional single muted colour.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Dramatic, low-key; light drawn out with eraser.
styles.texture_characteristics: Paper grain, dust, finger smudges, fixative speckle.
styles.composition_characteristics: Strong value contrast; large dark areas; one lit focal zone.
styles.time_optic_fit: Proven in project (story sets 1–80). Good for emotional storytelling; not for product colour accuracy.
common_mistakes: AI fake text in dark areas
styles.prompt_template: Expressive charcoal drawing of {subject} in {setting}, deep velvety blacks and smudged greys, bold sweeping strokes, highlights lifted with an eraser, {lighting}, {composition}, visible paper grain and charcoal dust, monochrome, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Expressive charcoal drawing of a young man squinting at his phone late at night, deep velvety blacks and smudged greys, bold sweeping strokes, highlights lifted with an eraser on his face from the screen, screen glow on the face, figure off-centre with a large dark room, visible paper grain and charcoal dust, monochrome, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Works well in this project's pipeline; keep characters consistent via seed and img2img. Tends to add extra fingers in dark hand areas.

styles.name: Academic Charcoal
styles.name_th: ถ่านแบบวิชาการ
styles.historical_background: Charcoal served for underdrawing and finished drawings (Tate, 'Charcoal'); academic cast and figure drawing taught measured proportion and tonal planes. The academic method is described here as craft.
styles.visual_characteristics: Measured proportions, planar tonal modelling, controlled gradients, clean background.
styles.line_characteristics: Light block-in lines, refined contours, varied edge control.
styles.shape_language: Simplified planes of form, then refined.
styles.color_characteristics: Monochrome; sometimes white chalk on toned paper.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Single studio light; clear light, half-tone, core shadow, reflected light, cast shadow.
styles.texture_characteristics: Fine paper grain, smooth stumped tones.
styles.composition_characteristics: Single subject, centred, ample margin.
styles.time_optic_fit: Fits trusted-expert content (optometrist portraits); slow and serious for daily feed.
styles.prompt_template: Academic charcoal drawing of {subject}, measured proportions, planar tonal modelling with clear light, half-tone, core shadow and reflected light, {lighting}, {composition}, fine paper grain, monochrome, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Academic charcoal portrait of a calm female optometrist wearing slim black rectangular glasses, measured proportions, planar tonal modelling with clear light, half-tone, core shadow and reflected light, single studio light from upper left, head-and-shoulders centred with generous margin, fine paper grain, monochrome, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Untested here; expect good tonal portraits; glasses may merge with eye sockets in shadow.

styles.name: Pen and Ink Crosshatch
styles.name_th: ปากกาหมึกแรเงาไขว้
styles.historical_background: Pen-and-ink hatching builds tone from line density; it is closely tied to the graphic language of engraving and etching (see Tate, 'Etching', for intaglio line printing from the early sixteenth century). As a drawing style it is craft practice.
styles.visual_characteristics: Tone built entirely from hatching and cross-hatching, crisp black on white.
styles.line_characteristics: Uniform or tapered pen lines; parallel, cross, contour hatching; stippling.
styles.shape_language: Clear contours; form described by hatch direction.
styles.color_characteristics: Black on white; optional sepia or one flat colour wash.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Clear directional light so hatch density maps value.
styles.texture_characteristics: Paper texture; slight ink bleed.
styles.composition_characteristics: Detailed focal area fading to open paper.
styles.time_optic_fit: Good for heritage/craft messaging and lens-anatomy explainers; AI hatching is often noisy at small sizes on mobile.
common_mistakes: random hatch noise not following form
grey digital shading instead of hatching
too dense to read at phone size
styles.prompt_template: Pen and ink illustration of {subject} in {setting}, tone built only from parallel and cross-hatching that follows the form, crisp black lines on white paper, {lighting}, {composition}, no grey wash, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Pen and ink illustration of an old optician's workbench with a lens edger, tools and a pair of glasses being repaired, tone built only from parallel and cross-hatching that follows the form, crisp black lines on white paper, single lamp light from the right, detailed centre fading to open paper at the edges, no grey wash, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
Victorian engraving of a specific book
styles.flux_notes: FLUX gives a convincing look at 1024 but hatch lines are often irregular; untested at scale in this project.

styles.name: Ink Brush (Sumi-e)
styles.name_th: หมึกพู่กันซูมิเอะ
styles.historical_background: Ink-and-brush painting with graded black ink on paper or silk is an East Asian tradition (Chinese ink painting, Japanese sumi-e) tied to calligraphy. No museum page was opened for this entry, so dates are not claimed; technique is described respectfully as practice.
styles.visual_characteristics: Graded ink from black to pale grey, decisive single strokes, large empty paper.
styles.line_characteristics: Calligraphic strokes with pressure variation, dry-brush splits, wet bleeding edges.
styles.shape_language: Essential, suggested forms; economy of strokes.
styles.color_characteristics: Monochrome ink tones; rare light colour accent; red seal-like accent should not be faked.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Not depicted directly; mood from ink density and empty space.
styles.texture_characteristics: Absorbent paper bleed, dry-brush fibre marks.
styles.composition_characteristics: Asymmetric, much negative space, subject at edge or corner.
styles.time_optic_fit: Fits calm, mindful content; respect the tradition — do not add fake seals or pseudo-calligraphy, and don't turn it into a novelty filter.
common_mistakes: fake red seal stamps and fake characters
styles.prompt_template: Monochrome ink brush painting of {subject} in {setting}, graded ink washes from deep black to pale grey, decisive calligraphic strokes with dry-brush texture, ink bleeding into absorbent paper, {composition} with generous empty space, no seals, no writing, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Monochrome ink brush painting of a few bamboo stalks in morning mist, graded ink washes from deep black to pale grey, decisive calligraphic strokes with dry-brush texture, ink bleeding into absorbent paper, bamboo on the right edge with generous empty space on the left for an eye-rest message, no seals, no writing, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: FLUX adds pseudo-characters and red seals by default; negate them in the prompt and remove in post if needed.

styles.name: Clean Ink Line
styles.name_th: ลายเส้นหมึกสะอาด
styles.historical_background: Clean, even-weight ink line illustration is a commercial and comics practice (McCloud discusses line economy in comics). Described here as craft.
styles.visual_characteristics: Even confident black lines, no shading or minimal spot blacks, lots of white.
styles.line_characteristics: Uniform or slightly tapered weight; closed contours; no sketchiness.
styles.color_characteristics: Black on white, or line plus one or two flat fills.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Mostly none; occasional spot-black shadow.
styles.texture_characteristics: Minimal; clean paper.
styles.composition_characteristics: Icon-like or spot illustrations; easy to layer under text.
styles.time_optic_fit: Strong fit — the brand already uses store line art and line-art dialogue styles; easy to recolour with brand tokens.
styles.prompt_template: Clean ink line illustration of {subject} in {setting}, even-weight confident black lines, closed contours, no shading, {composition}, pure white background, no text.

avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: FLUX gives decent line art but sometimes adds grey shading; vectorise and clean in post for brand use.

styles.name: Woodcut Print
styles.name_th: ภาพพิมพ์แกะไม้
styles.historical_background: In woodcut the artist carves away wood around the design so the image stands raised, inks the block and presses paper on it; woodblock printing appeared in Europe in the twelfth century for textiles, with images printed on paper by the late fourteenth century (Tate, 'Woodcut').
styles.visual_characteristics: Bold black shapes, gouged white lines, visible wood grain in solids, high contrast.
styles.line_characteristics: Chunky carved lines with V- and U-gouge marks; tapered cuts.
styles.color_characteristics: Black on off-white; optional one or two flat colours from extra blocks, slight mis-registration.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Expressed as black/white pattern rather than gradient.
styles.texture_characteristics: Wood grain, uneven ink coverage, paper texture.
styles.composition_characteristics: Strong graphic framing; dense pattern areas balanced by solids.
styles.time_optic_fit: Works for wooden/handmade frame stories and bold posters; low detail means the real frame should be a photo layer.
common_mistakes: too fine detail impossible to carve
styles.prompt_template: Woodcut print of {subject} in {setting}, bold carved black shapes and gouged white lines, visible wood grain in solid areas, uneven ink, {palette} as one or two flat colours, {composition}, off-white paper, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Woodcut print of a craftsman filing a wooden eyeglass frame at a workbench, bold carved black shapes and gouged white lines, visible wood grain in solid areas, uneven ink, deep green as a second flat colour, craftsman on the left with tools forming a diagonal, off-white paper, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Untested here; expect convincing broad look but often too fine detail; ask for 'chunky gouge marks'.

styles.name: Linocut
styles.name_th: ภาพพิมพ์ลิโนเลียม
styles.historical_background: Linocut carves a design into linoleum (usually wood-mounted), inks the raised areas and presses them onto paper; linoleum has no grain so it cuts in any direction and inks evenly; invented in the nineteenth century as flooring, it became popular for printmaking in the twentieth (Tate, 'Linocut').
styles.visual_characteristics: Bold flat shapes, smooth even ink solids, carved line textures, graphic contrast.
styles.line_characteristics: Curved fluid cuts (no grain), parallel gouge textures.
styles.color_characteristics: 1–3 flat colours, reduction-print layering, slight registration offset.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Graphic; light as carved line patterns.
styles.texture_characteristics: Even ink with small speckles, paper texture, ink edge squash.
styles.composition_characteristics: Poster-like, patterned backgrounds, strong silhouettes.
styles.time_optic_fit: Good handmade accent style; two-colour brand version (phthalo + peach) is easy to keep on-brand.
styles.prompt_template: Linocut print of {subject} in {setting}, bold flat shapes with smooth even ink, fluid carved line textures, {palette} in two or three flat colours with slight registration offset, {composition}, textured paper, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Linocut print of a pair of sunglasses resting on a beach towel with palm leaf shadows, bold flat shapes with smooth even ink, fluid carved line textures, deep green and peach on cream paper with slight registration offset, top-down centred composition, textured paper, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Untested here; FLUX usually blends linocut and woodcut; specify 'no wood grain'.

styles.name: Etching and Engraving
styles.name_th: ภาพพิมพ์กัดกรด/แกะโลหะ
styles.historical_background: Etching coats a metal plate (traditionally copper, now usually zinc) with an acid-resistant ground; lines scratched through it are bitten by acid, inked and printed; metal etching decoration dates from the fourteenth century and printmaking use became common in the early sixteenth (Tate, 'Etching'). Engraving cuts lines directly with a burin.
styles.visual_characteristics: Very fine dense lines, cross-hatching and stipple, plate tone, crisp blacks.
styles.line_characteristics: Hair-fine to swelling lines (engraving), freer wavering lines (etching).
styles.color_characteristics: Black, sepia or sanguine ink on cream paper; optional hand-tinting.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Value through line density; dramatic or even.
styles.texture_characteristics: Plate mark border, ink tone wiping, soft paper.
styles.composition_characteristics: Framed vignette, plate border, classical arrangement.
styles.time_optic_fit: Nice for 'history of spectacles' content and premium heritage brands; detail breaks at phone size, so crop close.
styles.prompt_template: Etching print of {subject} in {setting}, fine dense lines with cross-hatching and stipple, soft plate tone, crisp blacks, {palette} ink on cream paper, {lighting}, {composition}, faint plate-mark border, no text, no captions.
styles.prompt_example: Etching print of an antique pair of pince-nez spectacles lying beside a magnifying glass and an old book, fine dense lines with cross-hatching and stipple, soft plate tone, crisp blacks, sepia ink on cream paper, single side light, centred still life with faint plate-mark border, no text, no captions.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Untested here; FLUX tends to add captions; negate text.

styles.name: Risograph Print
styles.name_th: ภาพพิมพ์ริโซกราฟ
styles.historical_background: The RISOGRAPH stencil duplicator was introduced in 1980 by RISO (founded 1946 in Japan by Noboru Hayama) per the manufacturer's history page; it prints one ink colour per drum pass. Its use by zine and small-press makers is widely reported but was not verified on a primary page here.
styles.visual_characteristics: Spot-colour layers overprinting, grainy halftone, slight mis-registration, bright fluorescent inks.
styles.line_characteristics: Bold shapes and simple lines survive best; fine detail breaks up.
styles.color_characteristics: 2–3 spot inks (e.g. fluorescent pink, blue, yellow, green) whose overlaps create new colours.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Flat; light via halftone density.
styles.texture_characteristics: Grain, uneven ink coverage, uncoated paper.
styles.composition_characteristics: Zine/poster layouts, generous margins.
styles.time_optic_fit: Good for young-audience or event posts; fluorescent inks clash with the calm brand palette, so use a phthalo + peach two-ink version.
common_mistakes: mis-registration so strong it looks broken
CMYK full colour instead of spot inks
grain applied uniformly as a filter
styles.prompt_template: Risograph print of {subject} in {setting}, two or three overprinted spot inks in {palette}, grainy halftone, slight mis-registration, flat graphic shapes, {composition}, uncoated paper texture, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Risograph print of a student wearing oversized clear glasses reading in a library, two overprinted spot inks in deep green and warm peach, grainy halftone, slight mis-registration, flat graphic shapes, student centred with bookshelves as repeating stripes, uncoated paper texture, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Untested here; may produce full-colour digital art with grain; emphasise 'two spot inks only'.

styles.name: Screenprint Poster
styles.name_th: โปสเตอร์ซิลค์สกรีน
styles.historical_background: Screenprinting pushes ink through a stencil on a mesh screen, one layer per colour; it became a prominent fine-art and poster method in mid-twentieth-century pop art (Tate, 'Pop art' covers the movement; no Tate screenprint page could be opened, so the process is described as craft).
styles.visual_characteristics: Flat opaque colour layers, crisp stencil edges, halftone photo layers, slight overlaps.
styles.line_characteristics: Stencil-cut edges; outlines as separate dark layer.
styles.color_characteristics: 3–6 flat opaque inks, strong contrasts, occasional fluorescent.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Flat; shading as halftone layer.
styles.texture_characteristics: Ink edge squeeze, slight mis-registration, paper or fabric texture.
styles.composition_characteristics: Poster hierarchy with central icon; text space (text added in HTML).
styles.time_optic_fit: Good for promo posters with a bold single frame icon; keep text in HTML layer.
styles.prompt_template: Screenprint poster of {subject} in {setting}, flat opaque ink layers with crisp stencil edges, one halftone layer for shading, {palette} in four flat inks, slight registration overlap, {composition}, paper texture, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Screenprint poster of a single pair of bold black cat-eye glasses floating above a stylised Bangkok skyline at dusk, flat opaque ink layers with crisp stencil edges, one halftone layer for shading, deep green, peach, snow white and black inks, slight registration overlap, glasses centred with skyline at the bottom third, paper texture, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: FLUX often adds fake lettering in posters; negate text strongly.

styles.name: Collage / Mixed Media
styles.name_th: คอลลาจ/สื่อผสม
styles.historical_background: Collage, from the French papiers collés, became an artists' technique in the early twentieth century; Tate's earliest example is Picasso's Bottle of Vieux Marc, Glass, Guitar and Newspaper (1913), with later work by Hausmann (1919–20), Schwitters and Paolozzi (1948) (Tate, 'Collage').
styles.visual_characteristics: Cut and torn paper, photo fragments, layered textures, tape and paint marks.
styles.line_characteristics: Cut edges, torn fibres, hand-drawn doodles over photos.
styles.color_characteristics: Mixed sources unified by a limited accent palette.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Mixed; drop shadows from paper layers.
styles.texture_characteristics: Paper grain, halftone from printed scraps, tape, stains.
styles.composition_characteristics: Layered, scale contrast, deliberate pattern breaks.
use_cases: promo images combining real frame photos with art
styles.time_optic_fit: Very good: lets real frame cutouts sit honestly inside an artistic layout; easy in HTML layering.
common_mistakes: using copyrighted printed images as scraps
styles.prompt_template: Mixed-media collage of {subject} in {setting}, cut and torn paper layers, textured papers and painted marks, small paper drop shadows, {palette}, {composition}, scale contrast between elements, no readable text, no logos.
styles.prompt_example: Mixed-media collage background for an eyewear promo, torn kraft paper, deep green painted brush marks, a cut-paper sun and a Bangkok street scene in halftone, small paper drop shadows, deep green, peach and timberwolf palette, large empty centre left for a real glasses cutout, scale contrast between elements, no readable text, no logos.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: FLUX makes collages with pseudo-text; better to generate paper textures and assemble in HTML.

styles.name: Layered Papercut
styles.name_th: กระดาษตัดซ้อนชั้น
styles.historical_background: Paper cutting exists in many cultures; the layered shadow-box papercut look is a contemporary craft and digital illustration practice. No source opened.
styles.visual_characteristics: Stacked paper layers with soft drop shadows, clean cut edges, depth by layers.
styles.line_characteristics: Smooth cut contours; no drawn lines.
styles.shape_language: Simplified flat silhouettes, rounded organic forms.
styles.color_characteristics: Tonal gradient through layers (light front to dark back or reverse).
styles.lighting_characteristics: Soft top or back light producing small shadows between layers.
styles.texture_characteristics: Paper fibre, slight edge fuzz.
styles.composition_characteristics: Tunnel or stacked landscape depth; centred focal.
styles.time_optic_fit: Great for 2.5D parallax clips since layers separate naturally; frames as photo layer on top.
styles.prompt_template: Layered papercut illustration of {subject} in {setting}, stacked paper layers with clean cut edges and soft drop shadows between layers, {palette} graded from front to back, {lighting}, {composition}, paper fibre texture, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Layered papercut illustration of a river at night with floating krathong lanterns, stacked paper layers with clean cut edges and soft drop shadows between layers, deep green and navy graded to warm peach lights, soft glow from the lanterns, tunnel composition leading to the moon, paper fibre texture, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: FLUX handles papercut convincingly; layer separation for 2.5D still needs depth.py or manual masks.

styles.name: Embroidery / Textile
styles.name_th: งานปักผ้า
styles.historical_background: Embroidery is decorative stitching on fabric found in nearly every culture; it is presented here as craft, no source opened.
styles.visual_characteristics: Visible thread stitches (satin, chain, French knots), fabric weave, raised texture.
styles.line_characteristics: Backstitch or chain-stitch outlines.
styles.color_characteristics: Thread colours, slight sheen, limited palette.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Soft raking light shows stitch relief.
styles.texture_characteristics: Linen weave, thread sheen, hoop shadow.
styles.composition_characteristics: Centred motif in a hoop or patch; border patterns.
styles.time_optic_fit: Niche accent; a stitched glasses motif can work for a craft-themed post; little use for product detail.
common_mistakes: printed fabric look instead of thread

styles.prompt_example: Embroidery of a simple pair of round glasses with tiny flowers around them on natural linen fabric, satin-stitch fills, chain-stitch outlines and small French knots, deep green and peach threads with soft sheen, soft raking window light showing stitch relief, motif centred in a wooden hoop, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Untested here.

styles.name: Mosaic
styles.name_th: โมเสก
styles.historical_background: Mosaic assembles small pieces (tesserae) of stone, glass or ceramic into images and has ancient roots across the Mediterranean and beyond. No museum page was opened for this entry, so no dates are claimed.
styles.visual_characteristics: Small tesserae with grout lines, flowing rows (andamento) following forms.
styles.line_characteristics: Outlines formed by rows of tiles; grout as line.
styles.color_characteristics: Rich glass/stone colours, gold glints, flat per-tile colour.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Glass tiles catching light; flat image light.
styles.texture_characteristics: Uneven tile surfaces, grout, slight reflections.
styles.composition_characteristics: Frontal, symmetrical or patterned borders.
styles.time_optic_fit: Limited: decorative background or tiled-wall setting for sunglasses; avoid religious mosaic imagery.
common_mistakes: uniform square pixel grid (looks like pixel art)
styles.prompt_template: Mosaic of {subject} in {setting}, small irregular tesserae of glass and stone with grout lines, rows flowing along the forms, {palette}, {lighting}, {composition}, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Mosaic wall of a stylised sun and waves behind a café table, small irregular tesserae of glass and stone with grout lines, rows flowing along the forms, turquoise, cream and peach with a few gold glints, bright daylight, symmetrical design with empty lower area for a sunglasses product shot, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Untested here; expect grid-like tiles; ask for 'irregular tesserae, andamento'.

styles.name: Renaissance Realism
styles.name_th: สัจนิยมเรอเนซองส์
styles.historical_background: The Renaissance began in Italy around 1400, driven by renewed interest in ancient art and culture, with the High Renaissance c.1500–1530 and Michelangelo, Leonardo and Raphael as key figures (Tate, 'Renaissance'). Linear perspective and sfumato are standard art-historical associations, not taken from the Tate page.
styles.visual_characteristics: Balanced idealised figures, linear perspective spaces, soft sfumato modelling, calm landscapes behind.
styles.line_characteristics: Contours softened by modelling; precise architecture lines.
styles.shape_language: Harmonious geometry, pyramidal figure groups, classical architecture.
styles.color_characteristics: Clear harmonious colour, blue distance (aerial perspective), warm flesh.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Even soft light, gentle modelling.
styles.texture_characteristics: Smooth panel/fresco surface.
styles.composition_characteristics: One-point perspective, central symmetry, triangular groups.
styles.time_optic_fit: Occasional novelty or education; avoid parodying specific famous paintings or religious works for ads.
common_mistakes: modern glasses awkwardly pasted on a saint
styles.prompt_template: Painting in Italian Renaissance manner of {subject} in {setting}, idealised balanced figures, soft sfumato modelling, one-point perspective architecture, aerial perspective landscape, {palette}, {lighting}, {composition}, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Painting in Italian Renaissance manner of a scholar reading with early rivet spectacles in a study with an arched window, idealised balanced figure, soft sfumato modelling, one-point perspective architecture, distant blue hills through the window, warm earth and lapis blue palette, even soft daylight, centred symmetrical composition, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: Untested in project; FLUX tends to produce generic 'old painting' with pseudo-religious elements; specify secular scene.

styles.name: Baroque Drama
styles.name_th: บาโรกเร้าอารมณ์
styles.historical_background: Baroque was the dominant seventeenth-century style, peaking in Rome c.1630–1680 and spreading across Europe, marked by dynamic movement, bold realism and strong emotional appeal suited to the Counter-Reformation; Bernini, Rubens and Van Dyck are key figures (Tate, 'Baroque').
styles.visual_characteristics: Dramatic diagonals, theatrical light, rich fabrics, figures in motion.
styles.line_characteristics: Lost edges in shadow, swirling contours.
styles.color_characteristics: Deep warm darks, rich reds and golds, glowing flesh.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Strong chiaroscuro / tenebrism, spotlight from one side.
styles.texture_characteristics: Lush paint, velvet, satin sheen.
styles.composition_characteristics: Diagonal, layered depth, moment-of-action staging.
use_cases: luxury still-life of frames on velvet
styles.time_optic_fit: Good for luxury frame still lifes (dark velvet, single spotlight); heavy for daily content.
styles.prompt_template: Baroque-manner painting of {subject} in {setting}, dramatic diagonal composition, strong chiaroscuro spotlight, rich velvet and gold, deep warm shadows, {palette}, {lighting}, {composition}, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Baroque-manner still life of a gold-rimmed pair of glasses on deep green velvet beside a silver tray of grapes and a pocket watch, strong chiaroscuro spotlight from the upper left, rich fabrics and deep warm shadows, phthalo green, gold and crimson palette, diagonal arrangement, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
styles.flux_notes: FLUX does dramatic still lifes well; reflective metal frames may warp — keep real frame as photo layer for accuracy.

styles.name: Romantic Landscape
styles.name_th: ภูมิทัศน์โรแมนติก
styles.historical_background: Romanticism was at its height c.1780–1830, marked by interest in the natural world and personal feeling against classical restraint; Constable (1776–1837) and Turner (1775–1851) were central in Britain (Tate, 'Romanticism'). The sublime is a common association not defined on that page.
styles.visual_characteristics: Vast skies, dramatic weather, tiny figures in large nature, atmospheric haze.
styles.line_characteristics: Soft dissolving edges; expressive brushwork.
styles.shape_language: Grand organic masses: mountains, clouds, seas.
styles.color_characteristics: Atmospheric golds, storm greys, luminous skies.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Sunbursts, god rays, storm light, sunsets.
styles.texture_characteristics: Oil glazes and scumbles, misty passages.
styles.composition_characteristics: Low horizon, scale contrast, figure seen from behind.
styles.time_optic_fit: Suits eye-break nature clips and travel sunglasses moods; figures must be tiny, so not for product focus.
styles.prompt_template: Romantic landscape oil painting of {subject} in {setting}, vast atmospheric sky, dramatic weather and light, a small figure dwarfed by nature, soft glazed brushwork, {palette}, {lighting}, {composition}, no text.
styles.prompt_example: Romantic landscape oil painting of a lone traveller in sunglasses resting on a cliff above a misty sea at sunrise, vast atmospheric sky, dramatic light breaking through clouds, small figure dwarfed by nature, soft glazed brushwork, gold, slate and sea-green palette, low horizon with huge sky, no text.
avoid_phrases: in the style of <any living artist>
Wanderer above the Sea of Fog
styles.flux_notes: FLUX makes attractive epic landscapes; tends to HDR digital rather than oil; add 'glazed oil, scumbled sky'.

styles.name: Impressionism
styles.name_th: อิมเพรสชันนิสม์
styles.historical_background: Impressionism developed among Paris-based artists from the early 1860s, with a first group exhibition in 1874 and seven more until 1886; Monet was central, with Renoir, Degas, Pissarro and Morisot; artists worked en plein air with quick broken dabs to catch fleeting light (Tate, 'Impressionism').
styles.visual_characteristics: Broken visible brushstrokes, shimmering light, everyday outdoor scenes, soft edges.
styles.line_characteristics: No outlines; forms built from dabs.
styles.color_characteristics: Bright unmixed colour side by side, coloured shadows (violet/blue), little black.
styles.lighting_characteristics: Natural outdoor daylight, specific time of day, dappled sun.
styles.texture_characteristics: Thick-ish dabs, visible canvas.
styles.composition_characteristics: Snapshot-like cropping, everyday moments.
styles.time_optic_fit: Good lifestyle mood (people in sunlit cafés/parks); frames dissolve in dabs, so product must stay a photo layer.
styles.prompt_template: Impressionist oil painting of {subject} in {setting}, quick broken brushstrokes, shimmering natural light, coloured violet-blue shadows, unmixed colour dabs side by side, {palette}, {lighting}, {composition}, no text.
